name: claude-tool-use-assistant
description: A CLI IT-support assistant built on the Claude API with function calling: it runs real lookups (DNS, HTTP) and fills a ticket instead of only answering in text.

scripts.demo: node src/index.js --mock --yes --ask "Is example.org reachable, what does its DNS say, and raise a ticket for laptop LT-1042 which won't join Wi-Fi?"
